interactions.conditions: U8.2 is fed from /DC-DC Conversion/-13.5V OUT (U4 LM2596S-ADJ inverting output; the net also carries U4's bootstrapped GND/ON-OFF/TAB pins, D3.2, C9/C10/C11, R6.2, C16.1, C24.2 per the board-b baseline). The static -13.5V sits 16.5V inside the -30V abs-max; the rail's start-up/transient behavior and its level under load belong to the U4/D3 owner records and are unproven on Board B.

Net-(U8-OUT): U8.3 into C19 100nF MLCC + C25 470uF electrolytic (both grounded after the #93 Net-(C16-Pad2) merge) + R9 + PTC3.1 toward the -12V output. The datasheet application value is Co=1uF with no ESR window, so this network's stability is bench-gated on Board B.

The -13.5V rail to -12V output leaves 1.5V headroom against a 1.1V typical dropout at Io=1A (project rated 0.8A). Headroom is 1.0V short of the -14.5V guaranteed-band start and the dropout spec is typ-only; the board-b overview doc itself flags a full-load bench check for this rail.

1.2W continuous at the rated 0.8A versus PD 1.25W (Ta=25 degC) and RthJA 100 degC/W free-air implies a 120 degC junction rise; viable only if the Board B layout lowers effective theta-JA well below the free-air figure. The tab (pin 2) copper pour sits on the -13.5V input net, which constrains pour placement.
